title: Anatomy of a Challenge Card
description: Six required parts of a challenge card, and what each one is for.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Designing a Curriculum With Challenge Cards and Portfolios

educational.audience: Mentors writing cards for the rack

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given an unlabeled illustration of a challenge card, the learner identifies each of its required parts and what purpose it serves.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover any marker or label for that part and the job it does
